It is the missing companion of the public `@[simp] gradedMk_list_prod`; `gradedMkZero` currently has `mul`, `one`, `inv`, `pow` as `@[simp]` but no `list_prod`, so every later consumer (Layer 1.4, Layer 2) must re-prove it.

findings.issue: After the generalization, `exists_sum_gradedBracket_eq` is a literal specialization of `exists_sum_gradedBracket_eq_of_range` at `ι := ↥S`, `s := (↑)`, with no in-repository consumer; two public theorems now state one fact, and the old name survives only as the pre-PR surface.

summary: The `defect`/`level` surface itself is well formed (sealed bodies, `defect_def`/`mem_level_iff`, closedness, antitonicity, `@[simp]` where wanted), but three pieces of general graded/peripheral infrastructure the PR needed are hidden inside this file as `private` declarations or a proof-local `have` instead of being exported from their canonical homes, and the now-unused Finset spanning theorem is left behind as a duplicate of the new indexed one.
